title: Corporate Development Manager
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
 As a Manager on the Corporate Development team, you'll help shape Coinbase's inorganic growth strategy by leading the execution of M&A transactions, strategic investments, and market landscaping efforts. This team partners directly with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to identify and execute opportunities that advance Coinbase's mission and business objectives. You'll drive deal execution end-to-end, develop competitive intelligence that informs company and product strategy, and build relationships across the crypto ecosystem to keep Coinbase at the forefront of emerging opportunities.

 Lead execution of mergers and acquisitions and strategic investments, including sourcing, financial analysis, due diligence coordination, and integration planning in partnership with senior team members
 Conduct market research and synthesize findings into strategic recommendations that shape company and product direction
 Develop competitive intelligence on key players, analyzing relative strengths and weaknesses and translating insights into actionable implications for Coinbase

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Campaign Strategy & Execution
description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for an experienced Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Campaign Strategy & Execution to develop and execute campaigns that help users discover value, adopt key workflows, and deepen their use of Notion.

You'll own campaigns end to end: translating business and customer opportunities into clear strategies, defining audiences and journeys, coordinating creative and technical production, launching across email and in-product channels, and measuring incremental impact.

This role combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You'll partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product Marketing, Product Growth, Data Science, Marketing Operations, and creative partners. You should be equally comfortable shaping a campaign brief, building a journey in Customer.io http://Customer.io, resolving execution details, and interpreting results.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
About the role
 As Revenue Operations Manager for Enterprise GTM, you will own the measurement layer of our go-to-market engine. You will be the key to what is in the pipeline, what is converting, what is slipping, and, most importantly, why, and the . Your primary customers are our enterprise new logo and expansion teams across healthcare and life sciences, financial and professional services, TMT and energy, and public sector.
 We treat go-to-market as an engineered system. Architecture and design sit with the Director you report to. Instrumentation, measurement, and diagnosis sit with you.
 This is an individual contributor role with a wide mandate and real exposure. You will not manage a team. You will own numbers that go to the VP of Enterprise GTM, the executive staff, and the board.
 What you'll do
 Own the enterprise reporting layer
 Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility into pipeline health, stage conversion, sales velocity, coverage ratios, and attainment against plan, cut by vertical, segment, and rep.
 Establish a single agreed definition for every core metric (pipeline created, qualified pipeline, coverage multiple, win rate, cycle time, ACV, committed vs. consumed) and defend it. One number, one source, one definition.
 Report bookings, recognized revenue, and consumption as the distinct measures they are, and make the bridge between them legible to people who do not live in the model.
 Run the operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls in Salesforce and Clari, MBRs, QBRs, and the enterprise section of board reporting.
 Build stakeholder-specific, self-serve views so vertical leaders, sales development, and partnerships can answer their own routine questions without opening a ticket with you.
 Turn the data into insight
 Answer the hard "why" questions, e.g., why Stage 3 conversion dropped in financial services, which sourcing motions produce the highest-ACV enterprise deals, where multi-year agreements stall in…

title: Account Executive, AI Startups - Grower
description:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 The AI Startups team is focused on one of Stripe’s most strategic growth areas: enabling the monetization and scaling of AI-native and AI-enabled businesses. We are in a unique position to partner with the most ambitious AI companies at the forefront of artificial intelligence. Our team collaborates across infrastructure, foundational models, agents, and applications to support these companies in their growth and global commercialization using Stripe’s comprehensive financial stack.
 What you’ll do
 Responsibilities
 Own contract renewals and lead commercial negotiations to increase revenue and market share among existing customers.
 Develop and implement sales cycle strategies to drive product adoption, new sales, and client retention at scale.
 Address complex client needs by collaborating with product, sales, risk, and operations teams to enhance our offerings.
 Build and refine the go-to-market playbook for AI monetization and usage-based billing (UBB), including segmentation, messaging, sales strategy, and pipeline generation.
 Engage with AI founders and industry influencers to position Stripe as the preferred infrastructure for monetizing AI.
 Represent Stripe in market-facing activities (e.g., hackathons, webinars, events) to elevate our presence in the AI and billing ecosystem.

title: Professional Full Stack Engineer – PHP/Go + Flutter (m/f/x)
description:
Your mission
 About SIDES
 Restaurants are where people come together over good food. We build the technology that keeps them running.
 SIDES is the operating system for hospitality: POS, payments, delivery, kitchen tools, self-order terminals, apps and webshops on one platform. Thousands of restaurants run on it and millions of transactions flow through it every month, peaking on a Friday night when nothing is allowed to fail.
 We have the owner's and the chef's back, so they can focus on their food and their guests. And it is not just code on a screen: our software runs on real hardware in real restaurants, from POS devices to self-order terminals and more.

 Ensure operational quality with a strong focus on performance, security, stability, scalability, and observability

 Build clean APIs, well-designed data models, and high-performance user experiences
